items.title: Legacy refactor pipeline
items.problem: The most-modified service class in the AutoPath codebase needed refactoring no one could do safely by hand.
items.system: A 7-layer Python + agentic pipeline with characterization-test safety nets, following Working Effectively with Legacy Code.
items.outcome: Automated, reviewable refactors on shipped product code.

items.title: Team knowledge hub
items.problem: Tribal knowledge across 4 product lines lived in heads and stale wikis; onboarding was slow and AI tools had nothing to read.
items.system: A living PRD + onboarding hub + AI-consumable knowledge base, structured so both engineers and LLMs retrieve from it.
items.outcome: One source of truth for humans and agents.

items.title: Zero to daily AI adoption
items.problem: A skeptical embedded C++ team with 0% AI tooling use.
items.system: Workshops, live demos, prompting playbooks, and 6 custom AI skills for test generation, requirement extraction, and refactoring.
items.outcome: Daily Copilot use across the team.

items.title: ideaverse-os
items.problem: Personal knowledge vaults lock you into one AI tool and rot when conventions drift.
items.system: An npx CLI that bootstraps a position-addressed, harness-agnostic vault: any LLM agent reads the same structure.
items.outcome: Live product + template site; the system this portfolio runs on.

items.title: This site
items.problem: A portfolio should demonstrate the work, not describe it.
items.system: Dual-provider agentic chatbot (Gemini -> OpenAI fallback, 6 tools, rate-limited), zod-validated content pipeline, dev-mode inline editing.
items.outcome: The proof is the page you are on.
